subject.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides

question: Should the six user-reachable undocumented OPENCLAW_* inputs be removed immediately, or receive a bounded warning or migration window for existing deployments?
rationale: The repository favors one canonical path, but choosing whether released undocumented inputs deserve upgrade compatibility is a maintainer-owned policy decision.

options.title: Remove Immediately
options.body: Accept the inputs as unsupported implementation details and merge after fresh and upgrade real-behavior proof confirms the canonical paths.

options.title: Deprecate First
options.body: Retain the user-reachable inputs temporarily with diagnostics, compatibility coverage, and a named removal release.

options.title: Split Internal Cleanup
options.body: Land only the two test-control removals and defer the six runtime-input removals to separate compatibility decisions.

recommendation.title: Remove Immediately
recommendation.body: Accept the inputs as unsupported implementation details and merge after fresh and upgrade real-behavior proof confirms the canonical paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this person as the sponsor of the audit and the clearest owner for confirming its intended compatibility boundary.
